verdict.rationale: Bulk handling is a fair question for an online government immigration service, for example sponsors or applicants managing many applications at once. However, the evidence covers only individual online applications, processing-time checks and identity verification, with no documented capability to act on many items at once. Including dependants in one application is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
